projects.name: Insight Stream
projects.hook: Ever scrolled through hundreds of articles and Reddit threads just to find the few that matter to your work?
projects.meet: Insight Stream is a topic-based content intelligence platform that brings relevant information to you, shows public sentiment, and keeps you current on the areas you care about.
projects.what: It collects content from sources like RSS feeds and Reddit, organises it around the topics each user follows, and uses AI to classify sentiment, surface trends and power semantic search, so people find content by meaning instead of exact keywords.
features: Ingestion from RSS feeds and Reddit
AI sentiment classification: Good, Bad or Neither
Background processing, caching and authenticated access

projects.name: MoodVerse
projects.hook: Ever known exactly how you feel, but not which words to search for to find scripture that speaks to it?
projects.meet: MoodVerse is a spiritual reflection app that connects what people are going through with relevant passages from a trusted, curated collection of the Bible and the Quran.
projects.what: People describe their situation in natural language. AI analyses the reflection for emotional themes and meaning, and retrieval finds matching passages in a verified corpus. The model interprets the request; it never writes the scripture.
features: Retrieval from a curated, verified scripture corpus

projects.name: SEO Maker
projects.hook: Ever wondered why a site isn’t getting the search visibility it deserves, when the problems are buried across hundreds of pages?
projects.meet: SEO Maker is an AI-powered SEO intelligence platform that understands a website, finds the optimisation opportunities that matter, and recommends fixes based on real page data and business context.
projects.what: A crawling layer discovers and extracts pages, a processing pipeline analyses structure and SEO signals, and a rule engine with site context decides which findings matter. AI then explains issues and helps prioritise fixes, grounded in what was actually measured.
features: Website crawling and page data extraction
Page intelligence and structured SEO analysis
SEO rule evaluation with site-context awareness
AI recommendations grounded in real page data

projects.name: AlertChain
projects.hook: Ever waited for a coin to hit a price, then missed the moment because you weren’t watching the chart?
projects.meet: AlertChain, also called Crypto Mate, is a crypto monitoring and alert platform that watches market prices and notifies people when their conditions are met.
projects.what: It pulls price data from CoinGecko, stores market snapshots and evaluates user-defined rules, such as a coin moving above or below a target, on a schedule. Email and in-app notifications go out when a rule triggers, so nobody has to stare at charts.
features: Stored market snapshots and alert rules

projects.name: Workroom
projects.hook: Ever worked on a team where projects, tasks and decisions are scattered across tools, and nobody is sure who owns what?
projects.meet: Workroom is a business operations platform that helps companies organise projects, coordinate teams and streamline everyday workflows, with the right permissions and an AI assistant built in.
projects.what: It centres on departments, projects, collaboration and access control, so people only see the projects and information they are authorised to see. AI features run in a separate FastAPI service that complements the main Django application.
features: AI-assisted workflows via a dedicated AI service

cases.title: Trustworthy AI retrieval from curated knowledge
cases.q: How can an AI system understand a natural-language reflection and retrieve real source material without inventing the material itself?

sections.title: The problem
sections.body: People often know exactly how they feel but not which words to search for. A general-purpose LLM can meet them in natural language, but on its own it can also produce text that sounds like scripture and isn’t. In a spiritual product, an invented verse isn’t a minor bug. It breaks trust completely.

sections.title: The architecture and decisions
sections.body: I split the problem in two. Interpretation belongs to the model: Gemini reads the reflection and returns structured emotional themes. The text belongs to retrieval: semantic search with pgvector over a curated, verified corpus. Anything shown as scripture comes from a stored passage, never from generated output.
points: FastAPI with Pydantic v2 for typed request and response contracts
Supabase PostgreSQL with SQLAlchemy 2.x and Alembic migrations
pgvector keeps embeddings next to the source passages, with no separate vector store to sync
React Native client for a mobile-first reflection flow

rules: I prefer working features that survive real requests, failures and changing requirements.
Production FastAPI services with AI-integrated features at Andela.
Use an LLM where it creates real product value, not simply because an AI API is available.
In MoodVerse, Gemini interprets the reflection and never writes the verse.
Design integrations so providers, models and infrastructure can change without rewriting core application logic.
Insight Stream integrates OpenAI, Gemini, DeepSeek and Groq.
Move slow or heavy work out of the request path when it improves reliability and response time.
Celery and Redis run ingestion in Insight Stream and price checks in AlertChain.
For knowledge-based AI, use retrieval and trusted data instead of asking a model to invent facts.
SEO Maker’s AI explains findings from measured page data.
Prefer clear boundaries, observable workflows and boring infrastructure over unnecessary complexity.
Workroom keeps its AI service separate from the main Django app.

journey.title: User or system
journey.desc: A person or another service sends a request: a question, a search, or an event to process.

journey.title: API endpoint
journey.desc: A typed endpoint validates the input, checks auth and rate limits, then routes the work. Slow jobs go to a background queue.
journey.code:
✓ schema valid (Pydantic)
✓ token verified
✓ under rate limit
→ answers.create()

journey.title: Database
journey.desc: Two lookups run side by side: exact records from PostgreSQL, and meaning-based matches from a vector index.
journey.code:
sql:    plans WHERE seats >= 5
vector: top_k=5 "team pricing"
→ 2 rows, 5 chunks

journey.title: Knowledge
journey.desc: Results are ranked and trimmed into grounded context: the right facts, each with a source the answer can cite.

journey.title: AI model
journey.desc: The model reasons over that context only and returns structured output. Providers can change without touching the app.

journey.title: Response
journey.desc: The user gets an answer grounded in real data, with sources they can check, streamed back to the interface.
